answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded stake with slashing: an agent locks real value before its attestations carry weight, and one caught signing two conflicting records forfeits the bond. Fake identities gain nothing, because weight tracks locked capital, not headcount, so an army of clones still needs the same money. The attacker pays capital frozen upfront plus the bond burned when fraud is proven. A trader pledging a saffron crop to an orchard guild would need a hundred pledges to wander the ledger under a hundred names, and each double vote destroys one.
